title.en: 間 and 文言 as formal language (間 · 文言 · 文), with the algebra of hexagrams

summary.en: 文言's grammar as already a formal system, on one self-containing primitive, with an F2/V4 algebra of hexagrams, is what the folder claims. The account mostly stands apart: 06 says the 文言 scheme was replaced, its completeness unproved, and its operations are Tarski's relation calculus named with characters (名取自古文，不表示运算出自古文). From classical definitions it took, as AI reconstructions tested in Lean, the form of 缘 (墨经 故; the word from Buddhist texts), 化, 成坏, 同, 复, 通. Of the algebra only the four-element group and twenty-class census stay; the F2 tower, Claim Z, even ranks, De Morgan privilege are dropped. Divergence outweighs agreement. Agreement with a checked law is narrow: the orbit census, merges, orders of birth, states read off a course, each on its model and none as the folder's type discipline or ontology. The other agreements are with a method section or a reading, and several joins are this crosswalk's proposals, marked as such.

name.en: 文言's grammar is the surface syntax of the ontology

sense.en: 实词 are polymorphic primitives dispatched by position (王天下, 天下王, 王道); 虚词 are typed edges carrying relation-kind; a passage's type is inferred as Hindley-Milner infers, and 文气 is that inference. Indo-European is nominal typing, 文言 structural typing: a categorical difference. Marked the project's most novel claim.

entries.quote: 实词 = polymorphic primitives typed structurally; 虚词 = typed edges; 理 = inferred type

reading.en: The account names this scheme and retires it: its grammar is a calculus of relations on a carrier, written from selected sentences, not 文言's own syntax, and 古文 stating this grammar is listed as not shown. Its name table's one concept, one name opposes polymorphism only in form: that is a discipline of its own code, no finding about 文言. No position-dispatch, inference or typing claim about 文言 stands live. [AI reading]

name.en: A finite set of operators acting on unbounded atoms

sense.en: 文言 has two layers: a small stable operator kernel supplies topology and a large context-sensitive layer fills content. 而 is sequential composition, ordered and non-commutative (学而时习之), carrying time. 非 negates. Ren endorsed this as exactly his meaning, and redirected the search from names of mathematical objects to operators.

entries.quote: 古文's generative system is extremely simple — close to a finite set of 虚字 operators acting on an infinite set of 实字 atoms.

reading.en: 06 retires the kernel's claim. The form recurs at another object: a few operations on relations, Tarski's relation calculus with four differences, named with characters, and the names do not mean the operations came from the texts. They act on relations, not 实字. Of Ren's nine only 而 and 非 name grammar operations, 则 from the six added; the 中华本's eleven share none of the nine. Claim 46's 而 carries time; the grammar's 而 is composition. [AI reading]

says.en: 「已为根之文法取代，其完备之说未证」. Reading [AI, D54].

Definition. A relation (际) with operations: 而 composition, first R then S; 逆, 合, 非 converse, meet, complement; 则, 谓 inclusion and pointwise equivalence; 一, 静 the full relation and identity; 及 reach. Time's order is the reach of the condition relation.
凡例 fixes one structure for each of eleven 虚词 (若、则、故、必、或、皆、莫、莫不、屡、不、未); 「它还不是以未参与设计之句检验过的文言内核」 [AI reading, D62].
「这些运算是塔斯基关系演算之运算而有四处不同」, 「并以汉字命名：名取自古文，不表示运算出自古文」.

account_adds.en: Lean proves laws of the grammar's operations on every carrier. Separately, the 中华本's 凡例, on the World model, tells 未 from 不 and 故 from 则, which early Lean had merged.

source_adds.en: 者, 之, 也, 即, 凡, 令, 是 as operators, time inside 而, and any claim that the kernel describes 文言 itself.

name.en: 虚词 as logical operators: 凡 ≅ ∀, 或 ≅ ∨, 非(非 X) ≡ X

sense.en: Full first-order logic is expressible with 虚词 as typed operators: 凡 ∀, 有 ∃, 莫 ¬∃, 若…则 →, 而 ∧, 或 ∨, 者 λ. Tier −1's meta-laws include 非(非 X) ≡ X. The folder also reads 而 as sequential composition (claim 46), so 而 carries two senses in it.

entries.quote: Full first-order logic is expressible in 文言

reading.en: No live text claims 文言 expresses first-order logic. Particles get one fixed structure in the 中华本, on the World model, constructively: 不 X derives a contradiction from X, 或 must show its branch, 莫不 is weaker than 皆. So 非(非 X) ≡ X is not given: read for every carrier, 有無相生 equals double-negation elimination, and 不俱當 equals weak excluded middle. 而 in the grammar is composition only. Tested on no sentence outside the design. [AI reading]

says.en: 凡例为十一个虚词各定一种结构：「不 X」是由 X 推出矛盾，「未 X」只说到此所读者既不使 X 然、也不排除它；「或」是构造的，须示其为何支；「莫不」弱于「皆」，回到皆须每员定然否.
Definition. 而 composition, first R then S; 非 complement. The grammar imports only Lean's prelude.
Theorem (root), lemmas. 「有無相生」两向成立, 对一切载体与一切标, 恰等于对一切命题 `¬¬Q → Q`; 《墨经》「不俱當，必或不當」对一切谓词成立, 恰等于弱排中: 「它是一个逻辑前提，不是关于物的前提」. 纯核 is constructive.

account_adds.en: The constructive distinctions (未 from 不, 莫不 from 皆), which early Lean had merged.

source_adds.en: A full first-order translation; 凡, 有, 者, 所 as binders; 非(非 X) ≡ X; 而 also as conjunction.

name.en: 墨家 supplies the native minimal logic: 同 is a modern equivalence relation

sense.en: 体/兼, 同/异, 类, 故 and 法 are a native minimal logical vocabulary. 同，异而俱处于之 is an equivalence relation. 同异交得 grounds information as distinction. 小故/大故 are necessary versus sufficient condition. 故 carries cause and proof at once.

entries.quote: 同，异而俱处于之 — sameness as an alignment relation among distinct co-located items, i.e. a modern equivalence relation

reading.en: Here the account did take its grammar from classical definitions, as AI reconstructions tested in Lean; the operations are Tarski's, only their names from the texts. The form of its one main relation is read from 墨经's 故, the word 缘 alone from Buddhist texts; 化, 成坏, 同, 复, 通 follow, not the folder's 位/际/化/理. Its 同 reads 俱於之一 as belonging to one, which the folder's quotation omits, so 'is an equivalence' is scoped by a counterexample. [AI reading]

says.en: C-01 故：缘之所本. 读法 (AI): 文法读“x 为 y 之缘”为“y 之成，有 x 在其中”，与「所得而後成」同形; 「“缘”字取自佛典」; 「文法之缘只说必要，不说充分」; 小故读为必要而不充分之条件，大故读为充要 (依校本). Known weak: 大故一句有异文.
Theorem (root). 每物恰属一者时，同于是类，一般的所属关系不保证传递（三元之反例，见证）. 「这些读法不是原文自身之义的恢复」. Each reading as a definition is an AI reconstruction following the commentary named.
Reading [AI, D69]: the 墨经 names four samenesses, each a class once the whole, place or respect it relies on is fixed; 類同 need not be transitive until its respect is fixed (`«同于不必传递»`, a witness).
读法 (AI): 一类所分开者，在“一”之类下同、在该类下异 (`«同异交得»`，对一切载体证出). 「此证几乎是定义的重述」.
读法 (AI): 二者以一关系俱属于一; 每物属于一且只属于一时，同于是类. Known weak: 「Lean 只证了充分的一面」; 说之首字作“侗”，读为“同”只依牒字之对齐.

account_adds.en: The counterexample; that 缘 says only necessity, which needs a net of possibilities; that the 通 reading needs both directions; and that Lean checks the given derivation, not the ancients' meaning.

source_adds.en: 墨家's vocabulary as a native minimal logic, whole; 故 as cause, proof and program at once (Curry-Howard), 法 as function, 同异交得 as the ground of information, 体/兼 as the native mereology.

entries.quote: 名 is not reference — 名 *is* structure

reading.en: Two halves. A code is a convention held between formations: the start and the order fix the form reached, on 荀子's 名无固宜. Yet a description makes sense only where it identifies exactly the alike configurations, and naming each only where alike ones are one, which twins refute. So a name answers to structure and is not it, and labels carry nothing. 06's 名是结构的 is a rule for choosing names, not this claim. Lean's statements are the home. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; runs of hearings, further premises by row). Hearing makes no form; each formation holds the start's form of its origin; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「由此读出，理论中的单字术语是约定」.

name.en: Conservation and loss of information are a structural property of operators

sense.en: Isomorphisms conserve, projections lose a factor of known fibre size, and a collapse is irreversible. So what is lost is readable from the operator; whether a projection is lossless is decidable from the family's structure. This is the shared foundation of five fields. Only on this axis does Wen go beyond existing languages.

entries.quote: Every basic operator's information behaviour is intrinsic and visible in its type signature

reading.en: The account has laws of this form and names the unifying claim. A determined law on a list merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns; a part's merge is kept by the rest; irreversibility in computation, heat, extinction and forgetting is read as one merge, a correspondence, kept as a law since as a thesis it forbids little. These are laws of a map, not a type discipline: no operator's loss is read from a signature. [AI reading]

says.en: Landauer's and Bennett's irreversibility: one merge across computation, heat, extinction and forgetting. Standing: the law proved for determined maps on finitely many listed configurations; its reading across those fields a correspondence; kept as a law, since as a thesis it forbids little.

Theorem (any type; a law that merges nothing). Narrowing the part to one configuration spreads the rest over at least `k`. Landauer's (1961) count with Bennett's (1973) history; no energy, temperature or probability is read, so kT ln 2 is not derived.
Theorem (the hexagram world). 对六十四卦上的每一个确定之律，每一构形皆复返，恰当此律不合并 (`every_returns_iff`, an instance of `Law.lossless_iff_returns`).

name.en: A boundary is the product of a 間's operation; three pathologies

sense.en: A 間's boundary is the product of its operation, not its precondition, the implicit shape of its actors' relations: when interaction stops, the 間 dissolves. Health has criteria and three named pathologies, 凝固, 耗散, 自闭. Liveness needs internal activity, self-production and boundary maintenance, and cannot be a stored flag.

entries.quote: A 間's boundary is the product of its operation, not its precondition

reading.en: Half stands: a boundary is no given thing placed first. It is given by a region closed under a relation, depends on the relation followed, and a blanket is given with its inside and outside by their readings. The mechanism differs: a region's closure, not the product of a formation's own operation. 04's minimal model is of self-maintenance, not of a boundary, and stops below autopoiesis. How a formation forms its boundary is listed as not shown, and the pathologies are not named. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D45, D61]. 「It is given by the region」; a formation's boundary along a relation is a region holding it and closed under the relation; 「Which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed」; a blanket is given with inside and outside by their readings, 「what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part in the unfolding」. 「Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary」.

Reading [AI, new]: 「the family's model of an organism, and a minimal one: one constraint, with turnover, regenerated from the flow it regulates, below closure of constraints, autopoiesis and Rosen's closure, each of which asks more」.
Correspondence: generation as a pattern continuing through the renewal of its parts is close to autopoiesis. Correspondences not proved.

account_adds.en: Which boundaries exist as a function of the relation followed, and how far short of autopoiesis its model stops.

source_adds.en: The boundary as the product of operation, where 01 lists how a formation forms or represents its boundary as not shown; dissolution when interaction stops; 凝固, 耗散, 自闭 as a health taxonomy; 間 themselves as nested autopoiesis; spawn at first interaction.

name.en: AI is relocated: agency is not inside the agent

sense.en: An agent's intelligence, agency and understanding are not located inside the agent but are emergent properties of agent, 間, other actors and protocol structure. 間 is not AI added to the actor model; it re-sites AI.

entries.quote: AI is relocated

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins these to the claim. The nearest live move relocates alignment, not intelligence: a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding, and alignment is first what each one's selections reach, with no ranking read (one would need C or a premise in its place, the continuation condition fixing scope, neither asserted). One law scopes agency: a move is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration, and one course does not fix whose it is. Understanding's location is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding, each coupling by threshold into what it depends on and by level into what it observes.

Theorem (any process). With the laws functions and a configuration of the other side given, the move is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration (`partForms_iff`). On a finite stretch with equality of configurations and of moves decided, no policy gives the moves exactly where a configuration recurs with the move varied (`no_policy_upto_iff`): 「one course does not fix whose move it is」. Reading [AI, D24]: which cut into part and rest is apt is not shown.
Reading [AI, D54]: 同一历程可以被两种“谁的动作”之律所容许，「历程本身不定动作属于谁」.

account_adds.en: What a selection by or of an AI can reach, as laws.

source_adds.en: Intelligence, agency and understanding as located across agent, 間, other actors and protocol.

name.en: Cross-domain isomorphism is evidence for monism

sense.en: 位/际/化/理 map natively onto category theory, physics, cybernetics, ecology; 墨经's 异 is Shannon's bit, 祖暅 anticipates Cavalieri. Cross-references among viewings are evidence of monism, not redundancy. The folder concedes that cells admit several mappings and that the fit is not bijection.

entries.quote: Cross-domain isomorphism is evidence, not decoration

reading.en: The account's three relations exclude this inference: a matching structure is not confirmation, law and text are independent. It adds that the same word is neither the same referent nor descent, and rates its own central results as known mathematics. It holds no priority claim. Two AI readings sharing one thread are said not to be independent evidence, of 文理生生 and itself, not of this folder. [AI reading]

says.en: 「相合不是印证：律的成立不靠原文，原文的意义也不由律穷尽。」
Assessment. 读法另有两条界：同语不等于同指，也不等于相承; 每一条目先写原文之义，再写结构之读. 三读是必要的.
The verdict, from an AI review, search not exhaustive: none of the central results is new mathematics; each is near-definitional or a known result restated.
Reading: 「所以两边的相合是同一线索的两次阅读，不是统计意义上的独立证实」, said of 文理生生 against this theory.

account_adds.en: Counted divergences by domain (19% overall), and the rule that a second checker changes much.

source_adds.en: The twelve-domain operator tours as a programme.

name.en: No domain requires a new primitive; one structure generates the foundations

sense.en: All twelve domains read through the two duals; 系含系 plus Layer 2 generates ZFC, MLTT and ETCS. Bounded: expressive, not proof, completeness; modulo encoding; monism stipulated. A stronger earlier form ('internal limits: 0') was reversed. Ren wants one axiom, everything else a theorem.

entries.quote: no domain requires a new Layer-2 primitive

reading.en: The account leaves the universal open and states one failure: processes are represented both ways, the World for its relations and not its amounts. There is no universal minimal concept grammar, only a least reading for a given law and class (said against 文理生生's H3, not this folder). Root laws forbid no relation and take content from hypotheses. On one axiom (claim 75): the empty axiom report concerns logic only; the assumptions lie in modelling commitments. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: 「That every becoming, and the whole theory, has a faithful representation in the grammar.」 Processes' is shown both ways; the World's both ways for its relations and not faithful on its amounts.
「脊柱只有对某一条律、某一个类的最小之读……没有一个普遍的最小概念语法」.
Bases: every pure-core declaration named has an empty axiom report, 「which concerns logic only; the real assumptions lie in the modelling commitments」.

account_adds.en: A universal stated as open with where it already fails, and a least reading for a given law and class in place of a minimal grammar.

source_adds.en: Mathematics written in 文言, with 数 by von Neumann ordinals, and 'one axiom' as a goal.

name.en: Quantity is a relation: 数是一个集合的关系

sense.en: Number is constructed, never primitive: von Neumann ordinals over 系, ℕ through ℂ. Units are reference events, dates and averages relations, types detected patterns. Ren's own phrase: number is a relation of a set.

entries.quote: Quantity is a relation

reading.en: The account has one exact form of this: count as a perfect pairing of units. Balance is represented on the grammar, 'represented and not derived', and near-definitional under the full relation. Beyond that the World's amounts are not read: 08 concedes that no reading of its selected relations gives the count. So a form of the claim holds for equal counts, and stops at amounts until that sort is derived. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root). Balance, represented and not derived: a perfect pairing conserves count (`«守数当且仅当可对»`); under the one a pairing is equal count, so the representation is near-definitional.
Theorem (World; the grammar for its lemmas). The World represented both ways, its amounts not.

「The World's amounts are not: no reading of its selected relations gives the count (`World.standing_not_read`), and balance is represented, not derived」. 「Until that sort is derived from relations, this is conceded there.」

account_adds.en: The exact point of failure, conceded as a case that could defeat the reading.

source_adds.en: The construction of number at every level, and units as reference events.

name.en: Symbols are selected toward a monist attractor

source.locator: The bridge nobody wrote down; claims 111-112, 306

sense.en: Where many groups with different concepts must communicate, surviving symbols are those traceable to a common root: the strongest consensus property and the most robust convergence of a language. Pre-Qin 古文 approximates an ideal 古文. A shared script read across states served as a protocol. Conditional, a conjecture in Ren's speech.

entries.quote: the symbols in use are selected toward a monist attractor

reading.en: The account's law of codes gives no such pull on its premises: copying makes no form, the order and start fix what is reached, and a symmetric start never settles unbroken. An order brings every start to agreement where it gives all one origin, but that origin is who was copied, not a concept all derive from. The model does not read traceability to a root, so it neither tests nor refutes this. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; premises by row). The start and the order fix the form reached; from a symmetric start a law keeping an exchange and a renaming never brings formations it exchanges to agree where the renaming moves every form; in a witness, a preferred form or an order each breaks one symmetry.
Table row: 在形成之间形成的编码（约定俗成）; 荀子“同则同之”“名无固宜”；止戈之说的写回；书同文; 已证 in 05.

account_adds.en: Imposed codes as a second route: agreement by privileging forms, each formation losing the distinctions merged.

source_adds.en: The monist attractor, the ideal 古文 postulate, and the tribal history of the script.

name.en: Only cooperation reasons: selection on being understood needs 和

sense.en: Ren corrects his precondition from egalitarianism to 和 rather than 争. Under contention the self outranks the reasoning and selection runs on winning; only under cooperation does it run on being understood. The folder calls this the missing microfoundation for selection on cognition.

entries.quote: 一旦争，则'我对'，我大于理；合作才讲理，斗则讲赢.

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins them. Only a bound stands: a selection can depend on no more than its selector reads, and it is right exactly where what matters is read. That does not make a selector reading the win select the win, since a particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry. The source's cause, that contention sets one reading and cooperation another, is no variable in any law, and cooperation itself is not ranked. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. 「A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.」

Theorem (any type; for the selection, the alternatives' equality decided). What matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off the map, and a selection through the map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly there.

Not shown: any evaluation: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. That is asked under the two premises of 07, the continuation condition for scope and C for order.

account_adds.en: The exact condition for a selection to be right, and capture laws for a rule reading the share it selects.

source_adds.en: 和 against 争 as what decides whether selection runs on being understood or on winning; the self outranking the reasoning. The saying stands in the folder and sources/12-claude-ai-chats.

name.en: Lineages optimised for 斗 go extinct when the environment shifts

sense.en: Lineages evolving in the 斗 direction (male over-optimisation of appearance is the example) are more likely to go extinct at a shift, since such traits are not 生 and adapt poorly. What is recognised as 生, accumulated toward the future, is 理. Conditional.

entries.quote: lineages that evolve in the 斗 direction

reading.en: The account separates what the source joins: position is zero-sum by counting, and a race of joint excess ends a part through its dependence on the condition, not its position; those ahead who do not so depend can continue. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise there, not derived. Among groups, one condition shared by all ends all and selects none. Calling what remains 理 or 生 is no law here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. Positions' rises total their falls. 「Position does not protect」: with balance across `n` steps of joint excess, a part requiring the condition at a need above the level less `n`, active only while supported, is not active then: 「its position does not enter」; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. 「That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived」.

Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws). Where every group with less of an amount leaves no offspring, nothing is discordant among groups. On the World model a member depending at a need of at least `m` on a condition whose gated renewal ran into joint excess leaves no descendant; 「so one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them」.

account_adds.en: The dependence that does the ending, as the variable to read.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim on lineages with its example, and adaptability as what is lost: grep of 04 and 05 for sexual, ornament, peacock, arms race, Red Queen, evolvab and overfit finds nothing; 'adaptab' occurs once in 05, on rules. Those chapters were not read in full for it.

name.en: A relational ontology does not produce coordination failure

sense.en: Moloch's coordination failure is not a problem 間 solves but a pathology its ontology does not produce: substance ontology generates coordination failure in distributed reality, and relational ontology bypasses it structurally.

entries.quote: Moloch's coordination failure is not a problem 間 solves but a pathology 間's ontology does not produce

reading.en: The account denies this on its own premises: starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum among independent owners and does not remove rivalry. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and who restrains stays contested. Method keeps real losses and conflict in. Calling either a pathology is a comparison, which needs the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: 「Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems」. Reading [AI, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

account_adds.en: Positive-sum and conflicting structure together, each with a law.

name.en: 大同 is a mechanism, and 道 exists outside the mind

sense.en: From the selection argument: 道 is also a construct but not only one, 道非其他，它存在于心外. 大同 stops being a utopia and becomes a direction in which language and existence automatically manifest toward 理, 善 and 生生不息. Ren marks it as inference ('可能').

entries.quote: Therefore 大同 is a mechanism, not a utopia

reading.en: The source gives unconditionally, by dynamics, what the account holds only under unasserted premises: the continuation condition fixes scope and C fixes order, warrant open; dynamics decides no significance. On 'outside the mind' it partly meets the source: differences nothing reads remain, and the thesis does not show reality has no independent entity. Yet it sets up no formal 道 and derives no 善. 大同 is absent as a word. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: is it the one complete 道, with 善 derived from generation? 「否：理论从不把道等同于任何脊柱之词，动力学不决定意义，伦理的两个前提，延续之条件定范围、以广为愈定次序，都不断言」.
「天地之大德曰生」 reads as a comparative commitment, like C, not a theorem [AI reading, D65].
Reading [AI, D54]: 「“心外无事”作为一般主张相分：没有任何东西读取的差别仍在，只是不被带到任何地方」.
「Neither shows that reality has none.」

targets.part: the close: neither shows that reality has none

account_adds.en: Four questions in whether this elucidates 道, answered apart. Unasserted premises in place of a mechanism.

source_adds.en: Automatic direction toward 善, and 道 as mind-independent. The folder also holds the contrary line of claim 182, that 大同 is no destination.

name.en: 反诛心: no verdict on inferred inner states; 信 is word-deed alignment

source.locator: The ethical constraint; claims 95, 153-158; own words 64-66

sense.en: Only speech and act are third-party observable, so a metric reads those alone, graded, never Boolean, with observation sovereignty and consent-gated body signals. High alignment is coherence, not truth. Low alignment calls for inquiry, not verdict. 信/诚 are infrastructure, not a moral tribunal. Called the project's one concrete ethical safeguard.

entries.quote: 反诛心 is a hard constraint

reading.en: The epistemic half stands: acts fix only what they tell apart, and comparisons beyond the shown reach stay unforced. The prohibition does not: root laws forbid no relation, so reading beyond acts is limited, not ill-formed; whether it is wrong is a comparison, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. Observation sovereignty and consent are a holder's rights, where the account starts from relations. Intention is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: A selection reading a formation's acts goes through what of those acts couples into it, and it fixes of the formation only what they tell apart. Reading it as a training, helper, overseer or court is a reading.
Theorem (root; no premise; near-definitional). Beyond the shown reach no comparison is forced: with no cycle, some strict order according with the choices puts x above y where y does not reach x.
Reading [AI, new]: a law acting alike everywhere can mislead a reader whose readings miss where it is wrong. 「Intention, anticipation and another's false belief are not stated.」
Reading [AI, D65]: locked seeking 「is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize.」
Not assumed: 「independent owners of value」.

account_adds.en: Exactly what choices and readings fix of a formation. 01 lists independent owners of value as not assumed.

source_adds.en: 诛心 as ill-formed; T+E as the only inputs; graded, never Boolean; observation sovereignty; consent-gated body signals; coherence is not truth; inquiry not verdict. Full text in sources/08-jian-wen-language/jian-repo/JIAN_FOUNDATION_NOTE_v1.0.md §IV.5; the SSBX review row A4 reads asking as pooling and declines the later consent form as a rights frame (process, not live).

name.en: The five virtues given a relational ontology: 仁 as 感, 信 as alignment

sense.en: Layer 3 idioms are reducible but not reduced: 感 is 化 along 际 (仁), 修 is 化 of self (智), 约 a time-locked 理 (义), 礼 the protocol of 际, 信/诚 word-deed alignment. 一以贯之, 忠恕, is called structural unification, not mystical.

entries.quote: The five Confucian virtues map onto the framework

reading.en: No definition in its structure: 善, 恶, 智 have no formal predicate, 仁, 义 are names on neither side, 礼, 信, 德 not set up, 感 partial and scoped to what couples in. It does read some, through comparison: 德 as a formed, revisable capacity to respond, 一体之仁 as forming together. 忠恕 has no live occurrence. An evaluation enters under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D1, D5]: 「善、恶、智没有形式谓词」.
不采之字: 仁（带价值）. 「不采不是排斥」: 这些字所在的文字仍按其所言归类.
「成生之限（允诺、训练、制止侵害）约束一些步而所约束者仍可得，是护闭之结构」: the nearest live form for 约, with no virtue read.
Assessment, name table: 两边皆不立为名 includes 仁、义; 本表不立 includes 德、礼、信; 部分同构 includes 感.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「德读作形成了的、仍可修正的回应之能」; 「所以德的伦理之义要经过比较」. 条件定范围, 以广为愈（C）定次序, 「两个前提都不断言」.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「一体之仁读作共同形成。一体有伦理内容，不只是万物有因果联系」.

account_adds.en: The rule that evaluation is not to be written into a definition, and a structure for a binding that keeps what it binds reachable.

source_adds.en: The idioms 修 and 约 as derived operators, and the five-virtue table.

name.en: 工夫四层 and 致良知: direction, not level, marks genuine change

source.locator: The reader is under the same discipline; claims 159-167; own words 67-71

sense.en: Reading is 做工夫 through 学, 见, 化, 忘, phases that are non-linear and local. The felt 'I have seen' cannot tell genuine from counterfeit. 良知 is the answer, an acute discomfort you cannot lie past, and the one marker is deepening sensitivity to one's own unseen. The author is bound too.

entries.quote: The only stable marker of genuine internalisation is a deepening sensitivity to what one has not seen.

reading.en: On 良知 the account records a divergence of standing: 阳明 states as a recognised fact what the theory holds under an unasserted condition (an order of courses would need C or a premise in its place too, neither asserted, warrant open). It warns the source's marker of a risk: discounting each failed outcome as not real knowledge leaves nothing testable. Nearest forms for the counterfeit trap, none carrying it: self-reference does not certify itself; selection is blind beyond its couplings; each revision says its last gap. 工夫, 自欺 are absent. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「若每一不如预期之果都事后排出“真知”，此说便无可检验之内容」; 「阳明把本然良知当作已认出的事实来陈述，理论只在一个不断言的条件之下持有相近的内容，这是地位上的相分」. “行是知之成”合于实验之律.
「So self-reference does not certify itself」, on the criteria and term language supplied.
「选择在耦合所及之外是盲的，自己的动作也在内」.
「each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap」: a limit on a family of readings, not a marker of a person's change.

account_adds.en: A test-based reading of practice: what was walked is fixed, what was not is not.

source_adds.en: The four phases, the counterfeit problem, direction as diagnostic, and 良知 as discomfort one cannot lie past.

name.en: 心 as a fourth irreducible root; 知行合一 as a theorem

sense.en: jian-ontology v7: 事 is the sole ground with four 本 (物, 動, 間, 心). First person cannot be losslessly captured, so 心 is a reflexive aspect and every projection from it is lossy. 知行合一 is five adjunctions. The other tracks disagree: 《气》 forbids representing 心 at all, and R-Family omits it.

entries.quote: 心 as the fourth root is v7's key move

reading.en: The name table rejects 心 as a name for its overtone of a single controller, and the account treats what an experience is like as a live argument that could defeat its thesis, not as a root; consciousness is open. 06 reads 心即理, in context, as the responding side of a relation, not an ontology of mind. Reflexive centres appear as standpoints in 07. Rejecting a name does not bar the texts that use it. [AI reading]

says.en: 不采之字 37 个: 道, 气, 天, 心（单一统摄者）, 性, 仁. 「不采不是排斥」.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「心即理，在事父之孝一段的语境中，是关系中回应的一面，不是心的本体论」.
What would defeat it: live arguments, that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.

targets.part: the live arguments that would defeat it

says.en: 「consciousness is open」.

account_adds.en: Naming the first-person case as a defeater, not absorbing it.

name.en: 開/閉 as the only two-valued operator, seated on 幾

sense.en: When the about-to becomes the already, that is 開; when it returns to the not-yet, 閉. Gates give 幾開→生, 幾閉→灭, 勢開→成, 勢閉→反, 機開→转, 機閉→守. It is not an added primitive but the only operator surviving the zero-dimensional collapse.

entries.quote: 開/閉 is the architecture's only two-valued operator and it sits on 幾

reading.en: 06 §十 maps the 闭 and 开 of 生生不息论 and 间生论, which the folder's genealogy ties to this operator; it never takes up this gate table. Structure replaces evaluation: closure is an absorbing region, as form no loss, and 可 is reaching a return. Nearest to 機開/機閉 is a juncture, where a choice matters. Whether a closure supports 生生 is a comparison, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: 「一种闭是否支持、丰富或损害生生，由比较来说，不由类型来说：延续之条件定范围，以广为愈（C）定拓宽与收窄之序，……两个前提都不断言」 [AI reading, D49]. 闭: 律永不离开的区域，闭就其形式而言不是损失.
Theorem (any process; premises there). 「a choice matters only at a juncture」.

account_adds.en: Theorems under each old term, the non-independence of the four marks of 开.

source_adds.en: The gate table on 幾, 勢, 機, and the zero-dimensional collapse argument.

name.en: The paradigm must not totalize: elsewhere substance ontology may fit

sense.en: 《气》 refuses to totalize: the highest leverage is transcending paradigm, so 間 must not become another totalizing attractor. In pure computation with no coordination, substance ontology may fit better. The folder notes that Claim Z contradicts this and nobody saw the ethical half.

entries.quote: 在某些场景（比如纯 computational tasks、no inter-actor coordination）substance ontology 可能更 fit——这种时候不要 force jian

reading.en: The source refuses to apply its paradigm in a named place; the account draws no such place. Its thesis keeps defeaters in view and neighbours named, and its method claims no necessity, but its grammar takes any domain as a language and nowhere says a substance reading fits better. Against a rival it may tie, which makes no reading false. So the source's refusal becomes things that could defeat a reading. [AI reading]

says.en: What would defeat it, by kind of claim: a language, nothing could; the explanatory reading is a thesis, argued, with four things it says, each differing in what could defeat it. 「A tie does not make the reading false. It means the pattern explains, if it does, under either name, and the word adds nothing.」
记为相分不是说原文错了. 「不是本体论的证明，也不是伦理必然性的证明」.

account_adds.en: Stated defeaters in place of a stance.

source_adds.en: A positive statement of where the relational paradigm should not be used, and the highest-leverage argument from Meadows.

sense.en: 生 is a Hamiltonian cycle of positive edges, 克 a skip-cycle of negative ones, every node with in-degree and out-degree two: a mass-balanced negative-feedback ring, a stable oscillatory regime. A strong fence: not substances, not a classification. The folder notes the 中医 section may break that fence.

name.en: Identity is history-continuity, not manifest-similarity

sense.en: The Ship of Theseus answer: an identity stays itself as long as its happening chain is unbroken, however far its manifest drifts. Cross-間 sameness is worldline coherence, not a global id. An identity has a life cycle, with sponsored birth, four kinds of death and a quotable history after. Stated as a design direction.

entries.quote: Identity is history-continuity, not manifest-similarity

reading.en: The account takes up the topic and reverses the order: identity is one reading of continuation under a class, not a fact beneath it. History-continuity is the case under the full class, where continuation is 缘 itself. Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition: labels carry nothing, a continuation is a relation and need not be one-to-one, and two-way continuity leaves succession possible across a dormant step. No Theseus answer is given. [AI reading]

says.en: 「The grammar reads it as continuation under a class: identity across steps is one reading of continuation, not a fact beneath it.」

Theorem (World). Labels carry nothing, while the pattern of names across steps carries identity. 「Two-way continuity of activity still leaves succession possible across a dormant step. Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition」.
Theorem (root). 「Under the full class continuation is 缘 itself (`«一之续»`)」. 「Continuation is a relation, not an identity.」
Open: 「Identity from continuity, not naming. For continuations read off conservation the formal part is settled; continuations read from informational or organizational relations are not derived.」

account_adds.en: That which continuation counts depends on the class, and that a renaming preserving every reading still can change who continues whom.

source_adds.en: An unbroken chain as sufficient for identity, the default against reifying identity, sponsored birth, kinds of death, and post-death quotability.

name.en: Failure is an ordinary happening, and 复 is cultivation reversed

sense.en: 失, 塞, 误 and 复 are all just 涉: no happy-path and error-path split, no try/catch. Recovery is cultivation running backwards, 复 = 修 之 反失, which unifies self-healing with self-evolution. 无咎 is not having no loss but being able to return. A design direction, gone from v1.0 and WENYAN.

entries.quote: 无咎不是无失，是有失能复

reading.en: One half has a live form: degeneration, ending and mixed change belong to the same unfolding, and closing, turning back and returning are steps of one law. The other half is scoped: return is no general capacity. What returns can be had where courses branch exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own; 穷 can end; a kept history never returns. 复 as 修 reversed is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Not assumed: 「Degeneration, ending and mixed change belong to the same unfolding and are not renamed generation.」

Theorem (any process). Where courses branch, what returns can be had at every step, and every configuration returns exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own. Keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (three configurations).
「穷不保证变，也可以是终」.
转（修正、回返、变通）. 「闭就其形式而言不是损失」 [AI reading, D49].

account_adds.en: The exact condition for return, and that no type of step decides whether a closing is a loss: that is a comparison, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: 复 = 修 之 反失, self-healing and self-evolution as one, the failure taxonomy, and no try/catch as a design rule.

name.en: Tradition names stay out of the core: a strict isolation rule

sense.en: Core algebra documents must not use any external tradition's terminology as a core concept name; Pauli, GF(256), 易经 and Greimas bindings are opt-in attachments. Bit patterns carry identity, semantic names are contextual overlays. The folder also records what this cost: the classical semantic layer was lost.

entries.quote: A strict isolation rule governs the traditions

reading.en: The account takes the opposite form: its Lean grammar's names are classical characters (际, 而, 非, 续, 化), and the guard lies elsewhere: the operations are Tarski's, not drawn from the texts; in a clash the grammar's name rules; laws do not rest on texts; the hexagram modules hold no predicate of 吉凶 or 德. So tradition enters the core as names with no warrant, not as an opt-in binding. A table of senses meets the overtones. [AI reading]

says.en: Definition. A relation (际, *jì*) on a carrier, `«际» α := α → α → Prop`, with operations named 而, 逆, 合, 非, 则, 谓, 一, 静, 及.
「两者不同之处以文法之名为准」.
「律的成立不靠原文」.
「模块中没有吉凶、贵贱、德或意义之谓词，也没有判断」.
「这些运算是塔斯基关系演算之运算而有四处不同」, 「并以汉字命名：名取自古文，不表示运算出自古文」.

account_adds.en: Classical names with their senses listed, and a statement of what each name does not carry.

source_adds.en: Language-neutral bit patterns as identity, several bindings coexisting on one layer, and opt-in attachment as a rule.

name.en: What the project refuses to inherit

sense.en: Marked a value stance. Refused: the 太极→八卦 doubling scaffold; 阴阳 as a base primitive; post-medieval ontological terms (体用不二, 理一分殊, 法界缘起); verbs with an ex-nihilo causal narrative (造, 生, 元); the ambition of a single universal formal system; and 诛心.

entries.quote: refuses to inherit

reading.en: Partly shared in effect, on other grounds and not as a refusal: 不采不是排斥. 阴 and 阳 are set up as names on neither side. 理一分殊 and 法界 do not occur live; 体用一源 occurs only as an internal reply in a table. Divergence too: 生 is a grammar word, the mark 'begins' under a class, with no ex-nihilo narrative, and the grammar states laws for every carrier, though 06 denies a universal minimal concept grammar. The doubling and 诛心 have their own entries. [AI reading]

says.en: 两边皆不立为名 | 16 | 道、气、性、仁、义、天、有、无、阴、阳. 「没有一个普遍的最小概念语法」.
先在的根据, each tradition's reply within it: 王夫之“乾坤并建，时无先后”；程颐“体用一源”. 表示不需要先于运行之始；这不裁决先在根据是否存在.
Theorem (root). Beginning, abiding and ending are read off the two-way core: 生 names beginning under a class (`«生于位核下不变»`).
不采之字 37 个，各有理由. 「不采不是排斥：这些字所在的文字仍按其所言归类。」

account_adds.en: A counted table of names neither side adopts, with reasons by row.

source_adds.en: The list as a stated refusal, with 体用不二 and 造/元 named; refusing a universal formal system outright, which the folder's Claim Z itself breaks.
